english.title: Cause a vehicle and load exceeding 1.90 metres high to proceed to and beyond a toll point designated for cars only
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels' approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_

caused the vehicle the height of which, including any load, exceeded 1.90 metres to proceed to and beyond any toll payment point designated for motor cars only
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(v) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
